plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked polymer-alignment and strength diagram from Stephanie Kwolek (1965 notebook & US Patent 3,671,542) compares tangled amorphous nylon chains (~0.8 GPa tensile strength) against Kwolek's parallel liquid-crystalline poly-para-phenylene terephthalamide (Kevlar) rods linked by inter-chain hydrogen bonds (~3.6 GPa tensile strength at 1.44 g/cm³ density vs steel's ~0.5–0.8 GPa at 7.8 g/cm³).
